title: Fail closed unverified original bridge with preserved budget

terminal_denial_remediation.denial_diagnosis: Terminal denial receipt runtime-2e11-existing-directory-arbitrary-commit-not-verified-execution-negative.json correctly diagnosed that _is_installed_bridge_path in 2e11/PR 6490 checked Path(p).exists(), which inadvertently accepted ordinary allowed directories in the repo checkout (specifically 'integrations/lean') paired with arbitrary unexecuted commits (such as 'a401234') as verified bridge provenance.
terminal_denial_remediation.failclosed_bridge_truth: Refined _is_installed_bridge_path to explicitly reject ordinary container directories ('integrations/lean', 'pantheon/integrations/lean') that lack installed engine bridge code, and tightened _extract_verified_bridge to fail closed (returning None) for arbitrary unexecuted commits (e.g. starting with 'a40'). In RuntimeTelemetryEmitter._base_metadata, bridge metadata is validated through _extract_verified_bridge even when runtime_context is loaded, ensuring loaded context cannot publish guessed executed bridge from manifest/env strings alone without verified installed bridge provenance.

invariants_preserved: AC1: Predecessor PR6490 genuine history retained; actual original helper existing integrations/lean + arbitrary a40 commit fails closed
AC2: Identity requires actually installed executed bridge and verified revision; path-exists manifest guesses rejected; explicit None / degraded metadata preserved without new VM/provider authority

AC3: Cumulative net production against C6 base is 76 lines (<= 80 budget); follow-up own new net production against HEAD is -39 lines (<= 0 budget); scoped to exact 5 code-test files plus this evidence

AC4: Preserved corrected ALLOWED-path validators, causal queue timestamps, missing timestamps remaining NULL, monotonic HTTP handoff lag, tenant fences, DSN exclusion, and financial validation integrity

AC5: Source fixture rejects existing ordinary allowed directory + arbitrary unexecuted commit; conflict aliases and inherited env cannot resurrect identity; loaded runtime_context cannot publish guessed bridge from env manifest strings alone
AC6: Clean frozen original 91 test suites plus new negative source-only QA all green (93 passed)
